artifacts.summary: Five sequential prose phases (5.5 h) producing, in this task's summary only, the ready-to-file relay text for ModelChecker entries 200/219, ADEQUACY.md (A3, 7.1(iii-e), 6.1 sliced envelope, new tail-stability item, 7.4) and TRUST_PIPELINE.md, with the landed TailStable form, the HOA no-profile decision, published vocabulary, the permanent never-report-validity discipline citing the task-710 witness Phi, and implementation-time dangling-citation checks on both sides; nothing written outside specs/708_*/ and the paired repository read-only.

memory_candidates.content: Cross-repository relay tasks (BimodalLogic -> paired ModelChecker, read-only) have a stable deliverable shape: the task's own summary carries a re-run Verification Snapshot (live HEAD SHAs on both sides, declaration-site grep for every cited Lean name, anchor grep for every paired entry/row/section), then one ready-to-file section per amended artifact stating what it replaces, confirms (already their position) or introduces (new to their side), with every citation by fully qualified declaration name, never file:line. Plan it as sequential prose phases over one summary file, with the citation and boundary checks repeated after writing, because the 701 precedent found cross-repository drift between research and implementation.
